title: Tenant Operating System Studio Convergence Contracts

phases.objective: Provide repository-native convergence contracts for canonical semantics, current-main reuse, T006 identity/cutover decisions, T008 Phase1 owner decisions, portfolio evidence, and truthful no-mutation boundaries.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Run Spec015 contract, canonical-authority, live-delta, and Tenant-audit validators from the exact candidate tree
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The 30-concept ontology, exact-current-main field-level reuse at 0faee775cd0572b737fed8bc74e2580d9fca2878, seven T006 decisions, thirteen T008 decisions, historical portfolio evidence, Work Map, completion truthfulness, and no-secret boundaries pass while T006/T008 approval and all runtime implementation remain blocked.
steps: Validate exact manifest inventory and specification-only boundaries.
Validate 30 canonical concepts and prohibit authority inference from Tool, Package, Agent, Skill, Installation Revision, Execution Capsule, Effective Runtime Manifest, or projection visibility.
Validate current-main field mappings for package/component/install/capability/operation/tool/agent/skill/workflow/activity-pack/MCP/manifest/legacy-action semantics.
Validate T002/T003 evidence completion without persistence or runtime claims.
Validate T006 has seven decision candidates with pending owner approval and cutover_executed=false.
Validate T008 has thirteen owner-decision candidates with phase1_authorized=false and runtime_mutation_authorized=false.

Validate T008 covers package/component/install, authorization, data governance, knowledge provenance, model governance, FinOps, agency ownership, portability, external protocols, human approval, and Content Intelligence staging.
Validate canonical_capabilities as target semantic identity while global runtime cutover remains gated by shadow parity and rollback proof.
Validate historical portfolio snapshots independently from the newer current-main authority inventory.
Validate Work Map/completion truthfulness and no-secret boundaries.
assertions: No new wholesale solution_package_* persistence is approved.
Current package/version/install authorities are mandatory reuse inputs before Phase1 persistence decisions.
T006 and T008 are decision-ready but not complete.
No physical table rename, capability runtime cutover, migration, provider call, permission grant, candidate merge, deployment, or Production activation occurs.
MCP and future external protocols remain projections over Context Kernel and governed execution.
Content Intelligence cannot progress to external CMS effects before Package foundation, provenance, model/budget policy, certified provider binding, idempotency, and readback gates.

phases.objective: Implement Package/Component foundation and deterministic installation compilation by reusing or extending current-main authorities before adding higher product layers.
blockers: Exact-head CI is not yet certified.
Package publication semantics and generic Component persistence are not approved.
Immutable Installation Revision and typed requirement-binding persistence are not approved.
Required P0 privacy/data-governance boundaries are not implemented.
Model-governance and commercial-reservation runtime are not implemented.

planned_e2e_journey.actor: Tenant system designer and package reviewer
planned_e2e_journey.entrypoint: Create and compile a private tenant package through approved extensions of current authorities
planned_e2e_journey.terminal_outcome: One exact Brand sandbox installation resolves to an immutable revision and tenant-safe surfaces without implicit authority.
steps: Reuse current package/version/install authorities.
Reference canonical Agent/Skill/Workflow/Policy/Activity Pack assets instead of copying payloads.
Compile typed target/requirement bindings with lineage, revision vector and hash.
Prove all execution remains server-authorized and readback-governed.

phases.objective: Prove upgrades, rollback, fallback, backup/restore, delegation revocation, export and handover continuity.
blockers: Operational package/install runtime is not implemented.

planned_e2e_journey.entrypoint: Upgrade, degrade, revoke and hand over one installation
planned_e2e_journey.terminal_outcome: Conflicts, rollback, revocation and continuity are proven.
steps: Three-way upgrade.
Fallback/restore/rollback.
Delegation/connection revocation and handover readback.

phases.objective: Run bounded freelancer, agency/client, reference-package and read-only external cohorts.

planned_e2e_journey.terminal_outcome: Isolation, cost, fallback, rollback, revocation and handover readiness are proven.
steps: Pilot freelancer and isolated agency client Brands.
Pilot client-owned Tenant delegation/revocation.
Run approved reference packages only after foundation certification.
Verify read-only MCP discovery/denial/disable/revocation.

phases.objective: Verify governed migration, Production runtime, generated/external parity, health, isolation, recovery and truthful closeout.
blockers: Canary acceptance and Production authority absent.

planned_e2e_journey.entrypoint: Promote an exact verified release through governed paths
planned_e2e_journey.terminal_outcome: Production runs intended revisions with complete readback and rollback evidence.
steps: Verify exact-head CI/migration/main parity.
Run bounded Production readback and isolation checks.
Complete post-merge audit.
